fix: agent feedback round 2 — staging safety, hook visibility, status, push errors

1. Fix -a flag staging untracked files:
   Changed add_all() from `git add -A` to `git add -u`. The -a flag
   now only stages tracked modified/deleted files, matching git's
   native behavior. Prevents accidentally staging untracked files
   (an agent staged 8 unrelated files via ez amend -a).

2. Show hook-modified files after failed commit:
   When git commit fails (e.g., pre-commit hook reformats files),
   ez now detects which files the hook modified and reports them.
   Tells the agent exactly what changed and how to retry.

3. Wrap push PR update errors with context:
   When push succeeds but PR update fails (wrong base, GraphQL error),
   the error now says "Push succeeded but PR #N could not be updated"
   instead of raw GraphQL. PR updates are best-effort, not fatal.

4. Add working tree status to ez status:
   Both human and JSON output now include staged_files, modified_files,
   untracked_files counts. Agents don't need to run git status separately.

5. SKILL.md discoverability:
   Added ez status to self-review section, ez push --base to push section,
   prominent --from main reminder in startup sequence.

feat: auto-drop redundant commits during sync and restack

This fixes the case where a branch has commits that modify the same

feat: agent CLI UX — progressive help, error navigation, timing metadata, ez diff/parent

Agent-first CLI design applying three techniques:

- `ez` (no args) and `ez worktree` (no subcommand) show help and exit 0
- Agents drill down on-demand: ez → ez <cmd> → ez <cmd> --help

Technique 2 — Errors as navigation:
- Every EzError variant now includes actionable "what to do next" hints
- Clap errors intercepted with ez-style hints instead of generic messages

Technique 3 — Consistent output metadata:
- `[ok | 45ms]` or `[exit:3 | 120ms]` appended to every command on stderr
- Always on, no flag — agents learn command cost over time

New commands:
- `ez diff` / `ez diff --stat` / `ez diff --name-only` — diff vs parent branch
- `ez parent` — print parent branch name to stdout (pipeable)

- `ez commit` / `ez amend` — diff stat printed after commit by default
